scope: Investigation only; no production or maintained test edits in this turn

findings.cause: WebKit pointer activation blurs the focused player stage without focusing the native Play/Pause button. Keydown is scoped to the player, so keys delivered to BODY are not handled. Play restores stage focus only after the async play operation; Pause has no corresponding focus restoration.
findings.observed: Immediate Play then M succeeded in 1 of 6 control trials; synchronous stage focus during click succeeded in 6 of 6. Pause then 700ms wait then M also failed without correction and passed with correction.
findings.recommendation: Keep focus inside the component synchronously when activating transport controls; retain keyboard, form-input and multi-player scoping. Regression coverage should include both Play and Pause followed by shortcuts.
findings.correctionStatus: Validated using an in-page click listener only; production not changed.

findings.cause: Ordinary Tab skips native buttons under the observed macOS WebKit keyboard navigation policy; Alt+Tab reaches them.
findings.observed: Ordinary Tab reveals hidden player controls as intended. Alt+Tab reaches Play with timeline/back/forward disabled, in both minimal DOM and real loaded player.
findings.recommendation: Keep the ordinary Tab reveal assertion and use Alt+Tab for macOS WebKit native-button reachability. Do not override native tabindex or suppress the assertion.

limits: Browser-engine experiment, not physical Safari or iOS qualification.
No production changes, commit or push.
